__comment: FarmSense Brew — Grafana Dashboard: Agronomist View (Full)
__instructions: Import: Grafana → Dashboards → Import → Paste JSON
Set MySQL data source name to 'farmsense-mysql' before importing
title: FarmSense Brew — Agronomist Dashboard

panels.title: ☕ Coffee Leaf Rust (CLR) Risk Score — System Average
panels.description: Hemileia vastatrix infection probability based on current environmental conditions across all 5 nodes

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN clr_risk='HIGH' THEN 75 WHEN clr_risk='MODERATE' THEN 50 ELSE 25 END) AS risk_score FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: Current CLR Risk Level — Per Node

targets.rawSql: SELECT sr.node_id AS metric, CASE WHEN sr.clr_risk='HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN sr.clr_risk='MODERATE' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS value FROM sensor_readings sr INNER JOIN (SELECT node_id, MAX(recorded_at) AS latest FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY node_id) latest_sr ON sr.node_id = latest_sr.node_id AND sr.recorded_at = latest_sr.latest ORDER BY sr.node_id
SELECT ROUND(AVG(temperature),1) AS value FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
SELECT ROUND(AVG(humidity),0) AS value FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
SELECT ROUND(AVG(soil_pct),0) AS value FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: Irrigation Status
panels.description: Nodes with soil_pct < 35 AND clr_risk != HIGH

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sr.node_id) AS value FROM sensor_readings sr INNER JOIN (SELECT node_id, MAX(recorded_at) AS latest FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY node_id) l ON sr.node_id = l.node_id AND sr.recorded_at = l.latest WHERE sr.soil_pct < 35 AND sr.clr_risk != 'HIGH'

panels.title: ESP32 Node Status — All 5 Nodes (X Formation)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sr.node_id AS 'Node', sn.position AS 'Position', sr.temperature AS 'Temp (°C)', sr.humidity AS 'Humidity (%)', sr.soil_pct AS 'Soil (%)', sr.clr_risk AS 'CLR Risk', sr.confidence_pct AS 'ML Confidence (%)', CASE WHEN sr.soil_pct < 35 AND sr.clr_risk != 'HIGH' THEN '💧 ACTIVE' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🚫 WITHHELD' ELSE '⏸ STANDBY' END AS 'Irrigation', sr.recorded_at AS 'Last Update' FROM sensor_readings sr INNER JOIN (SELECT node_id, MAX(recorded_at) AS latest FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY node_id) l ON sr.node_id = l.node_id AND sr.recorded_at = l.latest LEFT JOIN sensor_nodes sn ON sr.node_id = sn.node_id ORDER BY sr.node_id

SELECT recorded_at AS time, ROUND(AVG(temperature),1) AS 'Avg Temperature (°C)' FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(recorded_at)/3600) ORDER BY time

SELECT recorded_at AS time, ROUND(AVG(humidity),0) AS 'Avg Humidity (%)' FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(recorded_at)/3600) ORDER BY time

SELECT recorded_at AS time, ROUND(AVG(confidence_pct),1) AS 'CLR Risk Score (%)' FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(recorded_at)/3600) ORDER BY time

SELECT recorded_at AS time, ROUND(AVG(soil_pct),0) AS 'Avg Soil Moisture (%)' FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(recorded_at)/3600) ORDER BY time

panels.title: CLR Risk Factor Analysis
panels.description: Breakdown of environmental contributions to CLR risk

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Temperature Risk' AS metric, CASE WHEN AVG(temperature) BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN 70 WHEN AVG(temperature) BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN 50 WHEN AVG(temperature) BETWEEN 18 AND 21 THEN 40 ELSE 20 END AS value FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR UNION ALL SELECT 'Humidity Risk', CASE WHEN AVG(humidity) >= 85 THEN 85 WHEN AVG(humidity) >= 80 THEN 70 WHEN AVG(humidity) >= 70 THEN 45 ELSE 25 END FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR UNION ALL SELECT 'Soil Moisture Contribution', CASE WHEN AVG(soil_pct) < 30 THEN 30 WHEN AVG(soil_pct) < 35 THEN 40 WHEN AVG(soil_pct) >= 50 THEN 50 ELSE 35 END FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

SELECT ca.created_at AS 'Time', ca.node_id AS 'Node', sn.position AS 'Position', ca.risk_level AS 'Risk', CONCAT(ca.temperature, '°C / ', ca.humidity, '% RH / ', ca.soil_pct, '% SM') AS 'Conditions', ca.alert_message AS 'Alert Message', CASE WHEN ca.is_resolved = 1 THEN '✅ Resolved' ELSE '⚠️ Active' END AS 'Status' FROM clr_alerts ca LEFT JOIN sensor_nodes sn ON ca.node_id = sn.node_id ORDER BY ca.created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) * 10 AS value FROM sensor_nodes
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sensor_nodes
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sensor_nodes WHERE is_active = 1

SELECT sn.node_id AS 'Node ID', sn.position AS 'Position', sn.description AS 'Description', '50 sqm' AS 'Area', CASE WHEN sn.is_active = 1 THEN '🟢 ACTIVE' ELSE '🔴 OFFLINE' END AS 'Status', sn.installed_at AS 'Date Added', CASE WHEN sn.latitude IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(sn.latitude, ', ', sn.longitude) ELSE 'Not set' END AS 'GPS Coords' FROM sensor_nodes sn ORDER BY sn.node_id

options.content:
🔧 Modular System Architecture

FarmSense Brew's modular design allows independent monitoring of multiple 50 sqm zones. Each zone operates autonomously with its own:

  • ESP32 Sensor Network: 5 nodes (DHT22 + Capacitive Soil Moisture v1.2) in X formation
  • Irrigation Control: Independent solenoid valve per node with CLR-aware logic
  • Data Pipeline: Node-RED processing → MySQL storage → Dashboard visualization
  • Dashboard Integration: All zones visible across Agronomist, Farm Owner, and Field Staff views

Each additional zone can be registered, configured, and monitored independently, demonstrating the system's capacity for incremental farm expansion beyond the pilot plot.
